leduc.note: Game value converged well within the plan Phase 8 bar (|diff| < 1e-4). Exploitability (the stricter, worst-case metric) did NOT reach the plan's 1e-3 target within a reasonable compute budget -- extrapolating DCFR's convergence rate, closing the remaining gap needs on the order of 672,000 iterations (~17h at the measured per-iteration cost), a scale of background commitment the user was asked about and declined in favour of locking the honestly-achieved figure. CFR+ was also measured on this game and converges WORSE than DCFR here (extrapolated ~0.023 at a matched 8000 iterations vs DCFR's actual 0.00917), so it is not a faster alternative. This is a real, reported number, not a target met by construction.
